title: afni_proc.py
description: Generate a tcsh script for an AFNI single subject processing stream

dsets.description: Specify the EPI dataset files. (e.g. epi_run1+orig, epi_run2+orig)
dsets.title: EPI Datasets

subj_id.description: Specify the subject ID for the script.
subj_id.title: Subject ID

out_dir.description: Specify the output directory for the script.
out_dir.title: Output Directory

blocks.description: Specify the processing blocks to apply (e.g. tshift volreg blur mask scale regress).
blocks.title: Processing Blocks

echo_times.description: Specify echo times for multi-echo data processing.
echo_times.title: Echo Times

stim_times.description: Specify files used for stimulus timing in -stim_times.
stim_times.title: Stimulus Timing Files

stim_files.description: Specify TR-locked stim files for 3dDeconvolve -stim_file instead of -stim_times.
stim_files.title: TR-locked Stimulus Files

copy_files.description: Specify additional files to be copied to the results directory.
copy_files.title: Additional Files to Copy

copy_anat.description: Copy the anatomical dataset(s) to the results directory.
copy_anat.title: Copy Anatomical Dataset
